rows.camera: Wide child-height three-quarter departure, screen-left travel. The spring remains behind/right; both friends walk on the same dry path. One full bucket in PinPin's paw, two leaf boats in Rabbit's forepaws.

en: They walked home together. The water swished softly in PinPin’s bucket.
ru: Они пошли домой вместе. В ведёрке Пин-Пина тихонько плескалась вода.
es: Volvieron juntos a casa. El agua se mecía suavemente en el cubo de PinPin.

rows.camera: Closer side tracking two-shot at child eye height, both still moving left along same path. Rabbit looks at PinPin while asking, PinPin turns his attentive eyes toward Rabbit. Full bucket remains visible, boats held by Rabbit.

en: “Why did the lake dry up that day?” asked Rabbit.
ru: «А почему озеро тогда высохло?» — спросила Зайка.
es: «¿Por qué se secó el lago aquel día?», preguntó Conejo.

rows.camera: PinPin's downward POV close-up into the ONE filled wooden bucket, briefly steadied at knee height. His small paws and a few shoulder quills edge the frame. Rabbit leans into upper/right frame, ears and face recognizable, listening and looking into the same water; both leaf boats held dry outside bucket. Ordinary sky/leaves reflected, no magic.

en: PinPin peered into his bucket. “I brought the water back. But where did it go? I don’t know.”
ru: Пин-Пин заглянул в ведёрко. «Я вернул воду. А куда она исчезла — не знаю».
es: PinPin miró dentro de su cubo. «Hice que volviera el agua. Pero ¿adónde se había ido? No lo sé».

rows.camera: Rear wide path shot, both walking away toward the small familiar moss-roof house glimpsed ahead through ferns. Neither points at invented clues; quiet companionship, attentive posture, bucket still full, Rabbit still carries two boats.

en: “That’s strange,” said Rabbit. They walked quietly for a little while.
ru: «Странно», — сказала Зайка. Они ещё немного прошли молча.
es: «Qué extraño», dijo Conejo. Caminaron un ratito en silencio.

rows.camera: Joint arrival at exact familiar stone cottage front, two round spoke windows flanking green round-topped door, same hinge orientation as05d. PinPin advances toward open doorway with one filled bucket; Rabbit stops at left side of step holding both boats. Mama may be in doorway and infant safely beside her as05d. Papa and Scooby absent on their parallel walk.

en: “I’ll wait here,” said Rabbit. “You take the water in.”
ru: «Я подожду здесь, — сказала Зайка. — А ты отнеси воду».
es: «Te espero aquí —dijo Conejo—. Tú lleva el agua dentro».

en: “Coming with me?” asked PinPin. “I’ll get our boats!” said Rabbit.
ru: «Пойдём вместе?» — спросил Пин-Пин. «Сейчас возьму кораблики!» — ответила Зайка.
es: «¿Vienes conmigo?», preguntó PinPin. «¡Voy a coger nuestros barquitos!», respondió Conejo.

en: “One bucket, Mama!” Mama held the door. “Thank you, both of you!”
ru: «Одно ведёрко, Мама!» Мама придержала дверь. «Спасибо вам обоим!»
es: «¡Un cubo, Mamá!» Mamá sujetó la puerta. «¡Gracias a los dos!»

en: Scooby came home with Papa. Rabbit lifted the leaf boats. “Hello, Scooby!”
ru: Скуби вернулся с Папой. Зайка подняла кораблики из листьев. «Привет, Скуби!»
es: Scooby volvió con Papá. Conejo levantó los barquitos de hojas. «¡Hola, Scooby!»

en: “I’ll take them back to the stream,” said Rabbit. PinPin waved goodbye. Scooby gave one friendly woof.
ru: «Я отнесу их обратно к ручью», — сказала Зайка. Пин-Пин помахал на прощание. Скуби дружелюбно гавкнул.
es: «Los llevaré de vuelta al arroyo», dijo Conejo. PinPin se despidió con la mano. Scooby dio un ladrido amistoso.

canonicalFinding: Original chapter01 says Lulu reports Crystal Lake has dried, PinPin draws a circle with his golden quill and water returns. It supplies no cause. These captions preserve that uncertainty and introduce no villain, cause, new lake geography or present magical effect.
continuity: One full wooden bucket throughout; Rabbit carries two retrieved leaf boats through five shots and waits at doorstep while PinPin enters.05f1 is their greeting to returningScooby, not a new arrival by Rabbit;05f2 is the only farewell.
